race_name: L'Étape Hermosillo by Tour de France

top_categories.workout_context: 74 miles on mostly flat and fast desert-to-coast road course burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic L'Étape Hermosillo by Tour de France's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
When someone attacks on mostly flat and fast desert-to-coast road course, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
L'Étape Hermosillo by Tour de France's mostly flat and fast desert-to-coast road course rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.

Road-specific control matters at L'Étape Hermosillo by Tour de France. Practice on mostly flat and fast desert-to-coast road course: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 74 miles.
Base fitness for L'Étape Hermosillo by Tour de France. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of L'Étape Hermosillo by Tour de France. Train it until it feels boring.
At L'Étape Hermosillo by Tour de France, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mostly flat and fast desert-to-coast road course at tempo for 74 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
2-minute all-out efforts on mostly flat and fast desert-to-coast road course. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at L'Étape Hermosillo by Tour de France. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.heat: October in Hermosillo to Bahía de Kino, Sonora, Mexico can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before L'Étape Hermosillo by Tour de France. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for L'Étape Hermosillo by Tour de France's 74 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 74 miles of mostly flat and fast desert-to-coast road course in Hermosillo to Bahía de Kino, Sonora, Mexico.
